original_tile.description: A vessel of freeblown glass curves at the lunar arc. The style hints that it originates from the coast of the Fuming God Sea, on the far side of Moghra'yi, and that it was likely exported by the dromads.

source_features: Long neck, flared mouth, round lower vessel and right loop handle. Lower source detail region is independently liquid-colored; the separate top pixel marker does not establish a floating physical cap.

source_behavior.scope: Native part/tag contracts retained, not evidence of measured glass opacity or a new tile/state family.

palette.rule: Neutral independent body/detail roles. Actual native palette, contents and seal behavior remain native.

donor_reference.role: Actual beer-bottle asset supplies restrained bottle highlights and edge weight only. No beer label, amber color, cap, straight silhouette or content is copied.

authored_interpretation: Hollow freeblown glass body and connected C-shaped handle, rolled mouth and low-complexity glass shading. Source top marker becomes a joined mouth glint, not a detached stopper. Depth, wall thickness and smoothing are authored.
states: One fixed source map tile for Random Bottle. Random liquid is content/palette, not evidence of random bottle shapes. No new seal animation, fill-level geometry, rotated furniture view or liquid simulation.

frame.rule: One full-cell mapping; no alpha-bound fitting.
